notes.title: We had to make a tough call
notes.notes: [p]Unfortunately, we had to make a tough call — the Leaforia demo won’t be available today. We'll release it during the next Steam Next Fest. It just needs more work and love to meet our standards. Thanks so much for your patience and support — it really means a lot. We promise it’ll be worth the wait.[/p]

notes.title: Great news!
notes.notes:
Leaforia Studio is excited to be part of June's Steam Next Fest with our Leaforia game!

We are still fine-tuning the demo, but it will be ready before the end of May.

The demo will be playable on June 9 during Steam Next Fest!!

Thank you so much for your support - we can't wait for you to play and share your thoughts!

notes.title: First!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We're alive![/b][/h1]

[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We know it's been pretty quiet on this page over the past few months — thanks so much for your patience! Since launching the game's Steam page, we've been hard at work getting [b]Leaforia[/b] to a place we're truly proud of.

[b]We’ve got an important announcement coming in the next few days, so stay tuned.[/b]

We're also planning to start sharing more updates about the game's development here soon!
